channel.title: Spatial Omics Radar — email digest
channel.description: New technologies, tools, AI models and benchmarks across spatial omics

item.title: Weekly update · 36 new entries
item.description:
36 new entries this week, spanning transcriptomics, histology / imaging-only, proteomics, multi-omics, and 3 more.

A Real‐Data‐Driven Framework for Evaluating Differential Transcript Usage Methods Across Long‐Read Bulk, Single‐Cell, and Spatial Transcriptomics
Evaluates differential transcript usage methods using real data across bulk, single-cell and spatial long-read transcriptomics.

SSMGCN
Multi-view graph convolutional network decoupling shared/specific spatial and expression information for spatial domain clustering.

Domain Elastic Transform
Grid-free Bayesian framework registering high-dimensional spatial transcriptomics functions without voxelization.

DiffGSP
Uses Fick's law and graph signal processing to reverse mRNA diffusion and recover true spatial expression.

CellDot
Optimal-transport framework reassigning or removing misassigned transcripts to decontaminate imaging-based spatial transcriptomics.

AINR
Implicit neural representation with attention maps spatial coordinates to gene expression for domain identification.

spaGFM
Graph foundation model pretrained on 43.9M cells to represent cellular neighborhoods across spatial technologies.

STCGCar
Graph contrastive learning framework with reliable augmentation for spatial domain clustering in spatial transcriptomics.

STAMGC
Dual-contrastive graph convolutional network that identifies spatial domains in spatial transcriptomics data.

SpaOT
Semi-metric unbalanced optimal transport framework for integrating and aligning spatial multi-omics tissue data.

SCIRA, GCSCAN, PathNet-TLS
Purpose-built tools for receptor-ligand quantification, TLS/germinal center delineation, and TLS detection on H&E.

Protocol for identifying cellular and molecular signatures from spatial profiling data using micro-tissue analysis
Protocol using partial least-squares modeling to find multivariate feature signatures in spatial profiling microenvironments.

ITO-PET slide
Conductive ITO-PET slide enabling sequential MALDI-MSI and LCM-proteomics on the same tissue section.

Halo
Pretrained model reconstructing whole-cell boundaries from nuclei images and transcript density in spatial transcriptomics.

Velociraptor
Machine learning workflow using marker enrichment modeling to register and match cell phenotypes across cytometry platforms.

PlantCCC
Graph-attention framework prioritizing context-specific ligand-receptor communication in plant spatial transcriptomics.

highSpaClone
Infers copy number alterations and tumor subclones from high-resolution spatial transcriptomics using spatial constraints.

CoexpressDeconvolve
Reference-free framework recovering integer cell counts and cell-type transcriptomes via topic modeling on spatial co-expression data.

Multi-Center Study on Sample Preparation and Feature Selection Effects in Reproducible Mass Spectrometry Imaging for Clinical Translation
Multi-center evaluation of sample-prep and feature-selection workflows for reproducible MALDI-MSI proteomic imaging.

MuSpAn
Modality-agnostic toolbox offering spatial statistics, topological data analysis, geometry and network tools for multiscale tissue analysis.

DPAS-Graph
Graph-based relation-learning framework predicting spatial protein abundance from spatial transcriptomic data.

LMDmapper
Desktop application mapping laser-microdissection pixel coordinates to stage coordinates for spatial sample tracking.

sosta
Bioconductor package for structure-based analysis of multicellular anatomical structures in spatial omics data.

FOCST
Predicts spatial transcriptomic profiles from histology images using foundation-model-driven contrastive learning and a GNN.

SPRINT
Reconstructs spatial proteomic (and metabolite) profiles by fusing spatial gene expression with H&E histology images.

EISCA/EISTA
End-to-end nf-core pipelines standardizing single-cell RNA-seq and imaging-based spatial transcriptomics analysis workflows.

CellART
Extracts single-cell information from high-resolution spatial transcriptomics via combined deep learning and probabilistic modeling.

spaCraft
Estimates statistical power and per-group sample size for multi-sample spatial transcriptomics studies from pilot data.

SpaCoEx
Sparse framework selecting genes based on spatially varying co-expression structure in spatial transcriptomics.

spAlignDE
Aligns spatial omics datasets across samples and modalities via diffeomorphic registration and estimates mismatch-aware differential expression.

SIMPlex
Generates matched spatial and single-nucleus transcriptomic profiles from a single FFPE tissue section.

RIPIN
An RNase-inhibiting tissue preservation protocol that improves RNA integrity for MERFISH spatial transcriptomics.

Independent benchmark of H&E-based gene expression prediction in skin
Independently benchmarks three published H&E-to-expression prediction models against simple baselines in skin.

PhenoMapR
Semi-supervised method mapping bulk expression phenotype signatures onto single-cell and spatial transcriptomic data.

SpotSweeper
Spatially-aware quality control method to detect local outliers and artifacts in spatial transcriptomics data.

ggsc
R package for visualizing single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data.
